notify_user.desc: Send a fire-and-forget desktop notification and return immediately. Use for progress milestones, completion, or errors that do not require a reply. Do not use when you need an answer; use ask_user instead.

params.message: Notification body text. Required and must not be blank.
params.title: Notification title. Default: "AI Assistant"; blank values fall back to the default.
params.level: "info" (default), "warning", or "error". Invalid values fall back to info.
params.duration_seconds: Requested display duration. Default: 5 seconds; maximum: 60. Some platforms may ignore duration.

ask_user.desc: Open a browser dialog asking the user one focused question. Returns a PENDING JSON object with a token; then poll get_user_response until the answer is not PENDING. Use only when a human decision/input is required. Details is required because the dialog is the user-visible prompt.

params.question: One short, focused question. Put reasoning, options, diffs, and context in details.
params.details: Required markdown context shown below the question: findings, concrete options, tradeoffs, proposed action, and recommendation. Do not rely on separate chat/CLI output.
params.title: Dialog window title. Default: "AI Assistant"; blank values fall back to the default.
params.subtitle: Optional subtitle shown under the title.
params.choices: Optional quick-reply chips. Empty strings are ignored; the user can still type a custom answer and attach images.
params.timeout_seconds: Idle timeout before the dialog returns a timeout message. Default: 600; maximum: 3600. Non-positive values use the default.
params.notify: Also send a desktop notification when opening the dialog. Default: true.

get_user_response.desc: Wait for a pending ask_user or rest token. Each call long-polls, then returns either a PENDING status message or the final user/rest response. Keep calling until the result is not PENDING. User replies are uncapped by default.

params.token: Token returned by ask_user or rest.
params.wait_seconds: Seconds to wait in this poll. Default: 55; maximum: 115. Non-positive values use the default.
params.max_response_bytes: Optional cap for final reply bytes. Default: 0 (unlimited). Only set when truncation is acceptable.

update_dialog.desc: Push a live markdown update into an open ask_user dialog while the user is deciding. Use for new findings or progress related to the pending question. Returns an error if the token is unknown, expired, answered, or unsupported.

params.message: Markdown message to display in the dialog updates panel. Required and must not be blank.
params.replace_last: Replace the previous update instead of appending a new one. Useful for progress counters. Default: false.

cancel_ask_user.desc: Cancel an open ask_user dialog. Use when the question is no longer relevant, the task was aborted, or you are replacing it with a better question. The next get_user_response call returns a cancellation message.

rest.desc: Put the AI into a resting state by opening a browser wake-up page for the user. Returns a RESTING JSON object with a token; poll get_user_response until the user resumes or the rest timeout fires. Use when the user asks you to wait, stand by, take a rest, or review.

params.notes: Optional markdown notes shown on the rest page. Summarize where work paused and what should happen next.
params.title: Name/title shown in the rest UI. Default: "AI Assistant"; blank values fall back to the default.
params.subtitle: Optional subtitle shown under the title.
params.timeout_seconds: Auto-wake timeout. Default: 3600; maximum: 86400. Non-positive values use the default.
